item.title: The Reason Behind Pokémon's Mysterious Social Media Countdown Has Been Revealed

description.p: Update: Brace for disappointment.The Pokémon Company is no stranger to a little over-hyping every now and then, but its latest bit of marketing has us seriously thinking that there is a big announcement in the pipeline.You see, TPC is counting down to... something. As brought to our attention by Serebii's Joe Merrick, the company has been sharing images on social media of its 30th anniversary icons, with a number underneath.
